content.text: Welcome to a brand new tool called league builder, available for free.

LeagueBuilder is a website that allows you to build league tables with as many competitors as you want, managing fixture generation, automatic league placements based on points, league tiers and much more.
I am very excited to announce this as it is something that has been in the works for a  while.
So what are you waiting for? Check it out now, completely for free!
